system.description: Scrawl a glowing correction across a foe within 30', as an editor strikes a line.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts until the end of your turn after next.
outcomes.success: Until the end of your next turn, attacks against the foe have Boon, and it gains nothing from cover.
outcomes.failure: The ink smudges: the foe gains nothing from cover until the end of your next turn, but attacks gain no Boon.
outcomes.ruin: The ink runs back up your arm: you defend with Bane until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
